hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has two entries Kele [khy] and Foma [fom]. The two are varieties of the same language (**hh:h:Hulstaert:Cuvette-Congolaise**:21, **hh:ld:Vinck:Carrington**:578, 581, **hh:s:Carrington:Likile**:67, **hh:hv:Bastinetal:Bantu**:208). See also: Foma [fom].
